answer: Standing evaporates unless it is re-bought every epoch, at a rising price per head. The beacon is a registry that groups identities sharing a funder, host or code fingerprint into one cluster. A thread, one seated identity, keeps its capacity only by burning ember, a fixed-supply token destroyed on payment, and unpaid capacity halves each epoch. The k-th thread in a cluster burns k ember per epoch, so an honest agent pays 1 while 100 clones burn 5,050 every epoch, forever. It breaks if clones cheaply evade clustering or ember gets cheap.
